title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-09-02
headline: Four Renaissance paintings stolen from a museum in Sicily during a holiday

questions.prompt: Who painted the Renaissance works stolen in Messina?
questions.hintKo: The painter was Antonello, not a runner or a phone company.

hintI18n.en: The painter was Antonello, not a runner or a phone company.

hintI18n.vi: Họa sĩ là Antonello, không phải vận động viên chạy hay công ty điện thoại.
hintI18n.pt-BR: O pintor era Antonello, não um corredor nem uma empresa de telefonia.

hintI18n.ar: كان الرسام أنتونيلو، وليس عدّاءً أو شركة هاتف.

questions.prompt: Why might the thieves have chosen a national holiday?
choices: Attention was on the festival, not the galleries
questions.hintKo: The holiday pulled attention outside, not inside the galleries.

hintI18n.en: The holiday pulled attention outside, not inside the galleries.
hintI18n.ko: 공휴일은 사람들의 관심을 갤러리 안이 아니라 밖으로 돌렸습니다.
hintI18n.zh-Hans: 假日把注意力吸引到了外面，而不是画廊里面。
hintI18n.ja: 祝日は注意をギャラリーの中ではなく外へ向けました。
hintI18n.es: El feriado atrajo la atención hacia afuera, no hacia el interior de las galerías.
hintI18n.hi: छुट्टी ने ध्यान बाहर खींचा, गैलरी के अंदर नहीं।

hintI18n.pt-BR: O feriado atraiu a atenção para fora, não para dentro das galerias.
hintI18n.id: Hari libur menarik perhatian ke luar, bukan ke dalam galeri.
hintI18n.fr: Le jour férié a attiré l'attention vers l'extérieur, pas à l'intérieur des galeries.

hintI18n.pl: Święto przyciągnęło uwagę na zewnątrz, a nie do wnętrza galerii.

questions.prompt: How did the thieves get the paintings out of the museum?
choices: They bypassed alarms and broke into a security display
questions.hintKo: They broke into a display; they did not buy tickets.

hintI18n.en: They broke into a display; they did not buy tickets.
hintI18n.ko: 그들은 전시품에 침입했으며, 표를 산 것이 아닙니다.
hintI18n.zh-Hans: 他们闯入了展区；他们并没有买票。
hintI18n.ja: 彼らは展示品に押し入ったのであり、チケットを買ったのではありません。
hintI18n.es: Entraron por la fuerza en una vitrina; no compraron entradas.
hintI18n.hi: उन्होंने एक प्रदर्शनी में सेंध लगाई; उन्होंने टिकट नहीं खरीदे।
hintI18n.de: Sie brachen in eine Vitrine ein; sie kauften keine Tickets.

hintI18n.id: Mereka membobol sebuah pajangan; mereka tidak membeli tiket.
hintI18n.fr: Ils sont entrés par effraction dans une vitrine ; ils n'ont pas acheté de billets.

hintI18n.tr: Bir vitrine zorla girdiler; bilet satın almadılar.
hintI18n.it: Hanno sfondato una vetrina; non hanno comprato i biglietti.
